    Polynomial lifts of the evaluated modules (Proposition 12.8, first part) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: for the family m + Σ_i t_i μ_i, "keep the underlying modules M_i ⊗ K and their vertex actions fixed", and lift the actions degree by degree, with the choices made separately in each degree and weight; all entries are polynomials.

    Here: the fibre at t is the algebra Fib (famMul t) with its length filtration (famPF), split by the identity (famSplit); its deformation terms are [q = 0]·m + Σ_{q_i = q} t_i μ_i (famSplit_μ). The lifted actions at t = 1 are chosen with relative weights in the monoid of the χ_i (exists_actFam_cone), and their twists are lifts for every fibre (famLifts), which are polynomial in t and specialize to the chosen lifts at t = 1.

      • q_pos (i : I) : 1 ≤ qd i
      • deg (i : I) : GExt.HDeg (galgA0 D hfin) (μ i) ↑(qd i)

      • one_right (i : I) (a : (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ) : ((μ i) a) 1 = 0
      • assoc (t : I → k) (a b c : (CatAlg.Alg D.F0)ᵐᵒᵖ) : ((famMul D μ t) (((famMul D μ t) a) b)) c = ((famMul D μ t) a) (((famMul D μ t) b) c)
